digest.component_or_area: store push subsystem (push.py, push_classify.py, push_recovery.py, push_state.py)
propositions: Expected best-effort push failures due to normal concurrent-writer contention (lost refs, transient transport retries) are surfaced at WARNING/INFO and prime agent sessions to unnecessarily investigate non-issues; these should be demoted to DEBUG or suppressed from agent-visible output entirely under normal load

Mid-retry transient transport fault notices in push_classify and push_recovery are logged at INFO+ but the code is already auto-retrying; these messages are pure worry-bait and should be demoted to DEBUG

Backlog count messages include a bare '..HEAD' suffix that conflates the tracker's HEAD with a session's code worktree HEAD and escalate counts across concurrent sessions without stating the self-healing contract
Policy declines (hook declined, branch protection), strict-mode failures, and proven-GROWING backlogs must remain at WARNING and operator-actionable; ordinary static backlog is not an outage signal

Current logging wording and level assignments conflate operator-actionable failures (policy declines, persistent growth) with expected self-healing contention outcomes, causing unnecessary token burn in LLM agent sessions
